rationale.headline: T21 is the clear favourite — its game style matches up well against T14.

drivers.label: Overall quality
drivers.detail: T21 has been the stronger side across the group stage, scoring more freely and conceding less.

drivers.label: Style matchup
drivers.detail: T21 leans on keeping the ball while T14 leans on sitting in a deep block; that clash is close to a wash.

drivers.label: How even it is
drivers.detail: T21 controls the kind of game it wants to play, which is why we make it the pick rather than a coin flip.

rationale.methodNote: Market-blind: multidimensional Elo (mElo). Each team carries a learned scalar rating mu (logistic gradient ascent on group-stage results, draws as 0.5, priors seeded from centred Elo) plus a fixed 4D tactical embedding c built from FIFA possession / high-press / counter-attack / low-block z-scores. Head-to-head advantage A = (mu_A - mu_B) + 0.35 * c_A^T Omega c_B with Omega block-diagonal cyclic [[0,1],[-1,0]], giving an antisymmetric non-transitive style-clash term; win prob = sigmoid(A), draw split via Davidson nu=0.85. Uses only on-pitch FIFA statistics and pre-tournament Elo priors — no market data was used.
